finding.summary: Session commit creates and schedules a linked timeout source for each asynchronous commit or refresh.
finding.explanation: CommitAsync runs at the session request boundary and allocates a linked CancellationTokenSource plus a CancelAfter timer before either storing or refreshing the session. Disposal is correct, but high-throughput session traffic can still pay per-operation timer scheduling and registration costs; workload evidence is needed to quantify impact.
